title: andropogon glomeratus var. hirsutior
intro: Andropogon glomeratus var. hirsutior, commonly known as Bahia grass, is a type of tropical grass native to the Americas. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bahia grass include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and relieving respiratory problems. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
